hypotheses.justification: Both hN and hk can be deleted together. Put n = k.toNat. Int.self_le_toNat gives k ≤ n, including negative k. From hj and hτ.2, k + τ - j < 0. Thus the absolute value is j - k - τ ≥ j - n - 1/2, which equals the left side by Nat.cast_sub hj. This works for every N, including zero.

The estimate holds for every integer k, independently of membership. Int.self_le_toNat gives k ≤ k.toNat; hj and τ < 1/2 then show the absolute value equals j - k - τ ≥ j - k.toNat - 1/2. Nat.cast_sub hj identifies this with the required bound. Negative k, where k.toNat = 0, also satisfy this argument. Both hk and hN can be deleted together.
